user.title: Connect a BlockFront player
user.description: Enter the BlockFront username and the statistics API base URL. Enter an API key only if its use has been authorized.

error.invalid_username: Enter a valid Minecraft username (3–16 letters, numbers, or underscores).
error.invalid_api_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS API base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_player: The BlockFront player could not be found.
error.cannot_connect: Could not contact the BlockFront statistics service. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This BlockFront player is already configured.

init.title: Statistics, activity, and refresh intervals
init.description: Choose how BlockFront data is refreshed. The activity sensor is optional; changing it takes effect when you save.

data.activity_cooldown_minutes: Keep personal data refreshing quickly after activity (minutes)
data.idle_heartbeat_minutes: Check personal data while idle or activity is unknown (minutes)
data.adaptive_margin_percent: Wait this extra margin after observed data changes (percent)
data.global_interval: Maps, trends, player counts and leaderboards refresh (seconds)

data_description.api_base_url: Base address of your statistics API. The integration uses this address for private player data.
data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the key already saved. Only enter a key if you are authorized to use it.
data_description.profile_interval: How often to check your BlockFront profile while personal polling is active.
data_description.matches_interval: How often to check for newly recorded matches while personal polling is active.
data_description.online_interval: How often to refresh the game-wide online player count.
data_description.status_interval: How often to check whether the statistics service is available.
data_description.activity_entity: Select a HASS.Agent Active Window text sensor or a binary sensor that specifically means you are playing BlockFront. This entity is not hard-coded; you can change or clear it later. Saving reloads the integration and switches to the selected entity.
data_description.activity_match: For a text sensor, activity is detected when its state contains this text, ignoring letter case. For HASS.Agent Active Window, use BlockFront. A matching window means it is in the foreground; it does not prove you are connected to a match. This setting is ignored for binary sensors.
data_description.activity_cooldown_minutes: After the selected sensor stops matching, keep checking personal data at the active rate for this long so delayed profile and match updates can arrive.
data_description.idle_heartbeat_minutes: When activity is off or unknown, check personal data this often. Online counts, global statistics and service status keep their own schedules.
data_description.adaptive_polling: Learn refresh timing from changes in source data and activity. Minimum and maximum intervals and API rate limits still apply.
data_description.adaptive_margin_percent: Wait this percentage beyond the observed source update cadence before checking again, to avoid polling before new data is published.
data_description.presence_mode: Auto follows the selected sensor. Force active keeps personal polling enabled. Force idle pauses personal polling. Game-wide data continues in every mode.
data_description.analytics_interval: How often to check recorded-match summaries and breakdowns while personal polling is active.
data_description.history_interval: How often to check personal history and rank snapshots while personal polling is active.
data_description.archive_interval: How often to check optional class XP and inventory snapshots while personal polling is active.
data_description.global_interval: How often to refresh shared game data. This continues even when personal polling is idle.
data_description.profile_source: Choose the primary source for profile statistics. Community API is the default.
data_description.matches_source: Choose the source for match history. Community API is the default.
data_description.community_api_base_url: Independent second provider base URL including /api/v1/. Does not change the primary source address.

error.invalid_api_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS API base URL without credentials, query, or fragment.
